posts.body_html:
Shucks ... you're embarrassing me :-). The site is difficult to find for a reason (sort of). It's been incomplete for the last nearly seven years. I'm good at a number of things, but web design isn't one of them. I traded plants for a college kid to set up the initial site, but he disappeared before teaching me how to maintain it. I've learned a bit here and there, but not nearly enough.

I have great hopes for it someday, however, as a place to host my in-habitat photos, my growlist and trade offerings, and other miscellany (published cultivars, articles I've written, etc.).

Speaking of cultivars, I just had two new ones published in the December issue of CPN. They finish my artist trio - S. 'Chagall' a S. x wrigleyana clone, S. 'Seurat' a S. x formosa clone and S. 'Gorey'. a S. x gilpini clone.
